facts.statement: The Station Cash bonus promotion ran Monday November 23 through Sunday November 29, 2009, and cards had to be redeemed within that week to receive the bonus.
facts.quote: Cards must be redeemed this week to receive the bonus Station Cash reward.

article_summaries.title: SOE Offers 25% Bonus to Station Cash Cards Thanksgiving Week
article_summaries.summary: Sony Online Entertainment announced a 25% bonus on retail Station Cash prepaid cards for Thanksgiving week (November 23-29, 2009). Station Cash cards were redeemable in Free Realms, EverQuest and EverQuest II, but the promotion excluded Free Realms Starter Cards. The article is a multi-game promotion notice, so Free Realms appears only as one redemption target.
